# Keep reopened draft values after a browser refresh

## What & Why
A recovered answer or opportunity currently stays in its form while the page is open, but a browser refresh can discard the in-progress reopened values. Preserving them would prevent users from losing work after the recovery notice has already been used.

## Done looks like
- Refreshing after recovering an answer restores the same open-form values without showing the old recovery notice again.
- Refreshing after recovering an opportunity restores the same open-form values without showing the old recovery notice again.
- Saving or explicitly cancelling clears the persisted reopened-form state.
- Add focused coverage in artifacts/escape-hatch/tests/persistence.spec.ts and keep the state handling in artifacts/escape-hatch/src/App.tsx consistent for both draft types.
